title: 766. Couples Holding Hands

examples.explanation: Swap chairs 1 and 2 to line up both couples.
Every adjacent pair is already a couple.
Reversed pairs still count as together.

hints: Keep a position table from person to chair so the partner of any seat is found instantly.
Walk the couches left to right: if chair 2k+1 does not hold the partner of chair 2k, swap that partner into place.
Each such swap fixes at least one couple and never harms an earlier couch, so the count is minimal.
